newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share prices seen moving in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share prices seen moving in narrow range.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are seen moving in a narrow range on Wednesday on expected speculative local buying of small stocks and profit-taking in big-caps, brokers said.
"Profit-taking is likely to continue in some big-caps, but I think the index would move narrowly due to active local buying of small stocks," one broker said.
The broker said trading was unlikely to be very active due to a lack of fresh market factors.
Sentiment was also likely to be cautiuous as people in Madura island off East Java began voting on Wednesday after violent protests over alleged vote-rigging following last Thursday's elections.
Big-caps Gudang Garam, Bank BNI and Bimantara closed down on Tuesday due to profit-taking, brokers said.
Brokers said small stocks which were likely to attract market attention included garment maker Karwell, property firm Surya Internusa and glue maker Kurnia Kapuas due to speculative reasons.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 1.33 points, or 0.19 percent, to close at 698.40 points.
